name: The Shops At Suffolk Downs
summary: The Shops at Suffolk Downs is a community shopping center in Revere, Massachusetts, built on the site of the historic Suffolk Downs racetrack. Conveniently located near the Blue Line and Logan Airport, it serves the diverse Revere and East Boston communities with essential retail and services.
demographics: The Shops at Suffolk Downs serves a diverse, working-class to middle-income demographic in the Revere and East Boston area, with a significant mix of families, young professionals, and multi-generational households. The trade area includes a substantial Hispanic and immigrant population, along with long-established Italian-American and Irish-American communities. Shoppers typically seek convenient, value-oriented retail options for everyday needs, with strong preferences for grocery, discount retailers, and service-oriented businesses that cater to busy family lifestyles.
description: The Shops at Suffolk Downs represents a modern retail transformation of the historic Suffolk Downs racetrack site in Revere, Massachusetts. Located at 40 Furlong Drive, this community shopping center serves the densely populated neighborhoods of Revere, East Boston, and surrounding communities with convenient access just minutes from Logan Airport and downtown Boston. The center provides essential retail and services to a diverse, multi-cultural community that has long been underserved by quality shopping options. With its strategic location near major transportation routes and the Blue Line MBTA station, The Shops at Suffolk Downs has become a vital commercial hub for residents seeking everyday necessities and services. The development is part of the broader redevelopment of the former Suffolk Downs property, which is being transformed into a mixed-use neighborhood that will eventually include residential, retail, and open space components, marking a new chapter for this historic Revere location.
